failure_summary.description: Skill lacks guidance on handling partial names/blanks and avoiding unnecessary generic descriptors, causing over-stripping or over-expansion of the target entity.

patch.reasoning: Both failures stem from the agent misinterpreting how to format answers when the question contains a blank/partial name or a placeholder. Trajectory 2 shows the agent stripping the known part of a compound name ('Funk' instead of 'Funk & Wagnalls'). Trajectory 1 shows the agent appending a generic descriptor ('power') when the gold expects a shorter canonical term ('hydroelectric'). Adding a targeted rule under Answer Precision will enforce returning the full canonical name for partial prompts while discouraging unnecessary descriptive additions.

edits.target: - If the context uses a surname, nickname, or single letter, prefer that form only if it is the primary identifier.
edits.content: - **Partial Names & Blanks**: When a question contains a partial name, blank, or underscore (e.g., '___ & Wagnalls'), always output the **full canonical entity name**, not just the missing fragment. Conversely, do not append generic descriptors (e.g., 'power', 'company', 'station') unless they are strictly required by the standard name; prioritize the exact shortest canonical form present in the context.
